title: Act 2 Scenes 2-4: Missing Characters and Silvius's Love for Phoebe
summary: Original passages from Acts 2, Scenes 2 and 4 with modern English translations, plus a narrative summary of missing characters, Frederick's orders to Oliver, and two shepherds discussing love in the forest.

title: Section 3: The Story So Far and Comprehension Exercises
